query.description: One Cosmos DB SQL SELECT, such as SELECT c.id, c.total FROM c WHERE c.status = @status. Across partitions the gateway refuses TOP, ORDER BY, OFFSET LIMIT, DISTINCT, GROUP BY and aggregates: give partitionKey for those.

parameters.description: Values of the query's @name parameters, such as {"@status": "paid"}: any JSON value.

partitionKey.description: The partition key value to read, such as "c-42" (an array of values for a hierarchical key). Leave it out to query every partition.

limit.description: Most items to return; the endpoint caps it.

cursor.description: nextCursor of the previous answer; leave it out for the first page.
